page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the weak category, with single-threaded gzip compression registering as poor. Conversely, multi-core performance is consistently average, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks also performs in the average tier.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is structured for workloads that benefit from parallel processing rather than high single-threaded clock speeds. Factual benchmark results show average performance for database operations, static web serving, and software compilation. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications, general-purpose web serving, and moderate database tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable resource density, though the lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage provisioning.
